apps/ui/src/pages/project/SummaryTab.tsx ResearchReads keeps the local line while `changed.over === cardLine`. If the card had not refreshed when the dialog closed, and a later change elsewhere restores exactly the earlier line (for example chat undoes the Overview change), the stale local line wins. Reproduced with the fake daemon: after the Overview added never facebook.com, the setting was deleted and project.changed sent, and the line still read 'Research reads: any public website, never facebook.com'. The earlier scratch test missed this because toHaveTextContent matches substrings. It did not happen on the real daemon, where the card refreshed within about 0.5 s, before close. Simplest fix: drop `changed` as soon as the card line changes at all.

GET /projects/:id/start-check now writes: waits.now calls noteWait, so opening the Start dialog, or the stopped bar's 'Continue where it stopped', records a wait. A session then starts by itself at the reset or once a credential is saved, even if the person only looked. This matches the sentence ('starts by itself') and design §1 ('work keeps going by itself'), but it is a GET with a side effect and is worth naming for the session lead.

compose credentialWaitNow builds the pick without the task's `answered` state and with modelTier fixed to 'sonnet'. A task whose person questions were already answered still gets the askPerson need, so in an edge case the Start check can say 'Nothing can run yet' while the real run would go to the subscription.

billing-pick takeReady computes `refused` once, from the snapshot it read before the version-checked write. A refusal written between that read and the write is treated as stale on the retry and cleared. The new comment claims such a refusal is 'either taken here or kept', which is not true for refusals. It heals itself at the next refused call.

Sibling of R-failopen that was missed: intake.ts onlyWebsitesLines, given an empty 'only' list, gives the planner '...only these websites and their subdomains: . Plan no research ...' (model-facing text).

Sibling of R-personsanswers that was missed: person-questions.ts isPersonTask still matches PERSONS_ANSWER on legacy titles without the RECORDED_ANSWER exception. Also, RECORDED_ANSWER removes the need for a whole text, so 'Follow the owner's decision in docs/x and get the owner's confirmation before deploying' loses the confirmation need unless NEEDS_PERSON catches it.

intake.ts: release() of the scheduler hold is not in a finally between store.session.start and the try that releases it. If userMessage or SessionBudget threw there, the agent would stay held, and every start would be queued until a restart. Low risk.

Wording for polish: during planning the Start dialog still says 'This session runs ...' (start-check busy does not count holds). After Start it says 'Queued: your agent is in another session. This one starts when that one ends.', but the person sees 'Drafting the plan', not a session.

Wording for polish: once a subscription has taken the work, the Inbox card 'Anthropic refused your API key ... The work that needs it waits and starts by itself then.' stays. That is true for the key, but the work no longer waits. setup also still returns restartNeeded: true for a subscription that now serves without a restart.

sandboxRefusalOf's `<launching>` filter does not match call-log lines that carry ANSI colour codes. Playwright printed '\u001b[2m  - <launching> ...' on this machine. This is harmless today because the markers are specific and never appear in a command line, but the guard the comment describes does not hold under colour.
